metadata.target_format: Interactive Fiction Novel / RPG Quest Outline

world_building.description: A bustling, seemingly normal school science exhibition that transforms into a high-stakes survival arena under specific conditions.
environmental_rules: The exhibition space loops infinitely if the exits are approached without an active anchor.
Creatures manifest physically based on the subconscious desires and memories of the attendees.

entities.name: The Confectioner / Ice-Cream Vendor
entities.description: An anomalous figure serving neon-colored ice cream. The flavors alter the emotional state of whoever eats them, lowering their guard to nearby threats.
entities.narrative_function: Acts as the environmental trap that induces the initial state of danger.

entities.name: Subconscious Manifestations (The 'Pokemon' Element)
entities.description: Creatures resembling childhood pocket monsters, but warped with surreal, organic textures. They shift from docile pets to predatory threats when the lights dim.
entities.narrative_function: Serves as the primary physical conflict and combat element for the protagonist.

narrative_architecture.inciting_incident: The protagonist eats a specific flavor of ice cream at the school exhibition, causing the crowds to vanish and the environment to distort.

three_act_structure.act_1_setup: Exploring the vibrant school exhibition, enjoying ice cream, and discovering a rare, creature-collecting exhibit.
three_act_structure.act_2_confrontation: The environment shifts. The collected creatures turn hostile. The protagonist realizes they are trapped inside a closed spatial loop with escalating environmental dangers.
three_act_structure.act_3_resolution: Using the specific properties of the ice-cream cart's freezing mechanism to neutralize the alpha creature and break the loop to return to the real school.

continuity_check.logic_reconciliation: The 'Pokemon' reference was abstracted into 'Subconscious Manifestations' to protect intellectual property and fit a darker urban fantasy tone.
